title: New Words Learned per Week
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vocab:review event=learned
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(new_cards) as new_words by _time
| eventstats avg(new_words) as avg_new
| sort - _time
description: Counts the new words you add to your vocabulary each week, a satisfying measure of steady growth.
value: Watching your active vocabulary grow week by week is motivating and helps you pace new learning sustainably.
implementation: Ingest new-card events into `index=personal`; total new words weekly.
visualization: Column chart of new words learned per week.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the new words you learn each week, a satisfying sign your vocabulary is growing.
